roles.label: ⭐ Partner (the boss this week)
roles.what: You run the pretend company. You set it up on day 1, switch your team on, say yes or no to money going out (the second person), approve customer notices, and decide about the new area.
screens: Me → ⚙️ Admin: People · Areas · Company & hubs · Price list · Who sees what · Custom fields · Settings
routine: 09:00 Open Home. Read Needs attention first.
Clear 👥 Approvals before 10:00 and again before 12:00 — nobody's money waits for you.
Answer any 📡 outage notice within 15 minutes.
11:45 Read the day's Friday report (Money → 📊 Report) and post one line in the team group: what went well, what went wrong.

roles.label: 💰 Finance (the money desk)
roles.what: You keep the money straight: cash counts, money in and out, bills, staff pay, billing-website files, and the reports.
screens: Money → ✍️ Record (Money out · Money in · 🧾 Snap a receipt)
Money → 📋 Bills (Bills · Pay run · 👥 Approvals · Staff & pay)
Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file (billing-website files)
routine: 08:45 Count the cash for both areas (Money → Count the cash).
Check 👥 Approvals: confirm the techs' receipts.
Record every payment the same hour it happens — never at the end of the day.
11:30 Money → 📊 Report: read it. Anything red → tell the Partner.

roles.label: 📞 Call center 1 (Town Centre desk)
roles.what: You answer the Town Centre customers: new sign-ups, problems, questions. You make the jobs and send a technician.
screens: Jobs (＋ New job · All techs · 📩 Today's texts)
routine: 09:00 Open Jobs → 📩 Today's texts: work every card.
Every call becomes something in Zuri: a customer, a job, a note or a task. Nothing stays only in your head.
Before you make a new customer, SEARCH first (name or phone) — no doubles.
11:50 Jobs → All techs: is any job without a tech or a day? Fix it.

roles.label: 📞 Call center 2 (Satellite desk + payment calls)
roles.what: You answer the Satellite customers and you make the payment calls. In an outage you tell callers what is happening.
screens: Jobs (📩 Today's texts · Payment follow-ups · outage banner)
routine: 09:00 Jobs → 📩 Today's texts.
If a red 📡 Possible outage box shows, read it to every caller from that area. No new visit needed.
A customer says “I paid”? Ask for the M-Pesa code, write it in a note, and make a task for Finance.
11:50 Tasks → My day: tick what you finished.

roles.label: 🛠️ Field tech 1 (Town Centre — installs)
roles.what: You connect new homes in Town Centre and fix what breaks. Your phone is your office: jobs, pins, photos, parts, money collected, receipts.
screens: Jobs → My jobs (To do · Done · 📍 Nearest first)
A job: ▶ I'm starting now · 📍 pin · 📷 photo · parts · ✅ Job finished
🧾 Snap a receipt · Me → 🧾 My receipts
routine: 08:50 Open My jobs. Tap 📍 Nearest first.
At every house: ▶ I'm starting now → pin → work → parts with serial → photo → what you found / did (tap at least one “What did you do?”) → money collected → ✅ Job finished.
Spent Zuri money? Snap the receipt the same minute.
Before you stop: My jobs → To do should be empty or have a note on each job.

roles.label: 🛠️ Field tech 2 (Town Centre — faults & businesses)
roles.what: You fix faults in Town Centre and look after the business customers (salon, hotel).
routine: 08:50 Open My jobs, nearest first.
Business customers first when they are urgent.
Collected money? Type the M-Pesa code every time.
Snap every receipt.

roles.label: 🛠️ Field tech 3 (Satellite)
roles.what: You cover Satellite: installs, faults, and the Satellite cabinet. On day 4 you find the cable cut.
routine: 08:50 Open My jobs.
If many Satellite customers are down, check the cabinet FIRST — tell the Partner what you find.
Snap every receipt.
Pins: stand outside the house, then 📍.

roles.label: 🎭 Customer voice (you play the customers)
roles.what: You are every customer. At the time on your script you phone (WhatsApp call) the call-center person named, say your lines, and check what they do. You are our toughest customer — but a fair one.
screens: Your script on the Testers' List (Business Week)
routine: Call at the time on the script (± 5 min).
Say who you are and your pretend phone number. Spell names if asked.
At the end of each call write what happened on your list: ✅ if they did it right, ❌ if not (say what).
Never give real numbers or real names of real people.

customers: Behind the Total petrol station, green gate
Near the matatu stage, blue door
Old Naivasha road, after the bridge
Kamuyu road, after the posho mill
Off the Suswa road, mabati house
Green house near the water tank

days.title: Open the doors
days.story: A brand-new, EMPTY company. No areas, no customers, no money yet. The Partner builds it at 09:00; by 12:00 we have two areas, a price list, a team switched on, staff and bills, opening cash, and our first four customers booked for installs.

ch.t: Sign in and make the company
ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in. Me → ⚙️ Admin → Company & hubs. Company name: Zuri Fiber (Business Week). Town: Maai Mahiu. Office phone 0700 000 800. M-Pesa Paybill 600100. KRA PIN P051234567X. Tap Save the company.
ch.end: “Company saved.” and the name shows when you open the page again.

ch.do: Admin → Areas. Add: code TC, name Town Centre, M-Pesa float target 30000 → Add area. Then code SA, name Satellite, float target 15000 → Add area.
ch.end: Two rows: TC Town Centre (30,000) and SA Satellite (15,000). The area picker at the top shows both (if not, pull down to refresh).

ch.do: Admin → People. For each tester: pick the job and area, tick On, Save. Finance = Office staff + Finance. Call center 1 = Call center, Town Centre. Call center 2 = Call center, Satellite. Tech 1 and Tech 2 = Field tech, Town Centre. Tech 3 = Field tech, Satellite.
ch.end: No “waiting to be switched on” line. Six people switched on with the right job. Tell the team group: “You are on.”

ch.t: Sign in (after the Partner switches you on)
ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in. If it says “Almost there”, wait for the Partner's message, then pull down to refresh.
ch.end: You see Home and the Money tab.

ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in. Wait for “You are on” from the Partner.
ch.end: You see Home, Customers, Jobs and Tasks.

ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in.

ch.end: Zuri opens from the icon. Bottom tabs: Jobs, Tasks, Me.

ch.t: Sign in and put Zuri on your phone
ch.do: Open the training copy, sign in, Add to Home screen.
ch.end: Zuri opens from the icon.

ch.t: Sign in and put Zuri on your phone

ch.end: Zuri opens from the icon.

ch.do: Admin → 💲 Price list. Add four packages: Home 5 Mbps 1500 · Home 10 Mbps 2000 · Home 20 Mbps 3000 · Business 30 Mbps 4500 (kind Fixed). The install fee is told to customers: Home 2,500, Business 4,500.
ch.end: Four packages in the list. (Call center sees them when they type a package on a new customer.)

ch.do: Admin → Company & hubs → ＋ Add a hub. Main office (Office / HQ), area Town Centre, landmark “Above the stage”, tap the map near the town centre. Then OLT room (OLT / server room, Town Centre). Then Satellite cabinet (Splitter cabinet, area Satellite).
ch.end: Three hubs with pins (no red “no pin”). Customers → 🗺️ Map shows the three hub icons.

ch.do: Money → 💵 Today → Count the cash. Area Town Centre: Bank 250000, M-Pesa 40000 → Save. Again for Satellite: Bank 60000, M-Pesa 12000 → Save.
ch.end: Cash today shows both areas. Satellite has an orange warning: M-Pesa float below the 15,000 target. Tell the Partner in the group.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → Staff & pay → ＋ Add a staff member, once for each person: Finance officer 25,000 · Call center 18,000 (two) · Field technician 20,000 (three). Use the tester's name, M-Pesa number 0700 000 901 … 906 (pretend), pay day 21, tick “Working for Zuri now”. The Partner is not on the payroll.
ch.end: Six staff, total KES 121,000 a month, all “paid on the 21st”. (PRETEND salaries — your real Business Week pay is separate.)

ch.do: The Customer voice calls you as Grace Wanjiku. SEARCH first (no one yet). Customers → ＋ New customer: Full name Grace Wanjiku (Mama Wanjiku), Area Town Centre, Status Lead, Phone 0700 000 101, Billing website ID BW-1001, Package Home 10 Mbps (pick it from the list), Monthly rate 2000, Directions “Behind the Total petrol station, green gate”. Save. Then ＋ New job: New install, “Install Home 10 Mbps”, Send to tech Tech 1, Visit day tomorrow.
ch.where: Customers → ＋ New customer, then ＋ New job
ch.end: Grace Wanjiku is a Lead with a New install job for tomorrow, sent to Tech 1. Tell her: 2,000 a month + 2,500 install.

ch.do: WhatsApp-call Call center 1. “Habari, I am Grace Wanjiku, they call me Mama Wanjiku. 0700 000 101. I live behind the Total petrol station, green gate. I want internet at home — what do you have?” Choose Home 10 Mbps. Ask “When can you come?”
ch.end: They told you 2,000 a month + 2,500 install, gave you a day (tomorrow) and a technician's name. Tick ✅ — or ❌ and say what was missing.

ch.do: Money → ✍️ Record → Money out. Area Town Centre. Paid to Wavetech Solutions. Amount 35000. Category Equipment / Inventory. Paid from Bank. Ref WT-4471. Open “More details”: VAT included 4828, Supplier KRA PIN P051111111A, receipt Paper receipt — filed. Save.
ch.end: It shows “waiting for a second person's OK”. The Partner approves it (10:30). Then it shows in the list as approved.

ch.do: Finance records 10 routers (KES 35,000). Open Money → 📋 Bills → 👥 Approvals. Read it (who recorded it, the amount, the VAT). Tap ✅ Approve.
ch.end: “✅ Approved: Wavetech Solutions, KES 35,000.” Nothing left waiting.

ch.do: You bought fuel for the motorbike. Me → 📸 Snap a receipt → 📩 Paste M-Pesa message. Paste the message (Copy button below) → Read the message. What was it for: Transport / Fuel. Area Town Centre. ✅ Save.
ch.end: “✅ Saved.” Me → 🧾 My receipts shows Total Energies 500 waiting for Finance.
ch.copy: UKA1BWFUEL Confirmed. Ksh500.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on 17/10/26 at 10:20 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh9,500.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → Add a bill, six times: Town Centre — Office rent 15000 due 21 (Rent & Utilities) · Safaricom backhaul 35000 due 23 (Telecom / Network) · KPLC prepaid 4000 due 19 · Staff transport 3000 due 21 (Transport / Fuel). Satellite — Pole rent 2500 due 22 · KPLC prepaid 2000 due 19. Put the “Pay to” from your role card.
ch.end: Bills for October: six bills, KES 61,500 owing, none paid.

ch.do: Mercy Atieno, Area Satellite, Lead, 0700 000 201, BW-2001, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Satellite estate, blue gate”. ＋ New job: New install, Tech 3, Visit day tomorrow.
ch.end: Mercy: Lead + install tomorrow with Tech 3.

ch.do: Call Call center 2. “I am Mercy Atieno, 0700 000 201, Satellite estate, blue gate. I want 10 Mbps.”
ch.end: A day and a technician (Tech 3) for tomorrow.

ch.do: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Site survey, “Market area: which shops want business internet”. Open it. Stand outside, tap 📍 Drop pin here. Add a photo of anything (pretend it is the market cabinet).
ch.where: Jobs → ＋ Log a job → the job
ch.end: The job has a pin and a photo.

ch.do: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Site survey, “Satellite: cabinet to the estate gate, 400 m of drop cable needed”. Drop a pin outside. Add a photo.
ch.end: Survey job with a pin and a photo.

ch.do: Same steps: John Kamau, Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 102, BW-1002, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Near the matatu stage, blue door”. Install job for tomorrow, Tech 1. He asks: “Can I pay by M-Pesa?” — Yes, to the tech, who types the code.
ch.end: John Kamau: Lead + install job tomorrow, Tech 1.

ch.do: Call Call center 1. “John Kamau, 0700 000 102, near the matatu stage, blue door. The cheapest one. Can I pay the install by M-Pesa?”
ch.end: Home 5 Mbps, 1,500 a month; yes M-Pesa to the technician; install tomorrow.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → 👥 Approvals. Tech 1's receipt (Total Energies, 500) is waiting. Look at the photo/message, then ✅ Approve.
ch.end: Nothing waiting. Money out shows Total Energies 500 recorded by Tech 1.

ch.t: Give the team their first tasks
ch.do: Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Book every install for tomorrow with a tech and a time” → Call center, High. Then “Pay day is the 21st — check Staff & pay” → Finance.
ch.end: Both tasks show under Team with the right group.

ch.do: Faith Achieng (Faith Salon), Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 103, BW-1003, Business 30 Mbps, 4500, “Market, shop 14”. Install job for tomorrow (Sunday afternoon), Tech 2, Priority Urgent (she wants it before her Monday customers). Business install fee is 4,500.
ch.end: Faith's Salon: Lead + urgent install tomorrow, Tech 2.

ch.do: Jobs → My jobs. Open each install for tomorrow. Read the customer, directions and package.
ch.end: Mama Wanjiku and John Kamau are in your list for tomorrow (Later).

ch.do: Call Call center 1. “Faith Achieng, Faith's Salon, Market shop 14, 0700 000 103. I need fast internet for the salon. Please come tomorrow — I open again on Monday morning.”
ch.end: Business 30 Mbps, 4,500 a month + 4,500 install; urgent install tomorrow afternoon.

ch.do: My jobs → Faith's Salon (tomorrow, urgent). Read it. Note the install fee for a business: 4,500.
ch.end: Faith's Salon is in your list for tomorrow, marked urgent.

ch.do: My jobs → Mercy Atieno's install (tomorrow). Read the directions.
ch.end: Mercy's install shows for tomorrow.

ch.do: Money → 👥 Customers → Next 30 days. Read the lowest point and the day it happens.
ch.end: A day-by-day list. Write in your Testers' List note: the lowest cash and the day. (No customers yet, so it only has bills.)

ch.do: The Customer voice asks: “How much are your hotspot vouchers?” We don't have a hotspot price list yet. Don't make a customer. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Caller asked hotspot voucher prices — what do we say?” Who: Partners.
ch.end: A task for the Partners. No new customer.

ch.do: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Site survey, “Walked Town Centre: poles from the office to the market cabinet”. Save. Open it, add a note “Pole at the market leaning — check”.
ch.end: Your survey job is in My jobs with your note under NOTES.

ch.do: Call Call center 2. “How much are your hotspot vouchers?” (You are not a customer.)
ch.end: They did not make you a customer. They said they will find out (a task for the Partners).

ch.do: Home → tap the 🏢 Headquarters card. Read Needs a decision, then Areas side by side, then Live activity (Last 24 hours). Scroll to The team.
ch.end: Both areas (Town Centre, Satellite) are in the table. Today's new customers and jobs are in Live activity, with who did them. Everyone you switched on is in The team.

ch.do: Money → 📊 Report. Read THE REPORT. It should show Town Centre and Satellite with today's cash counts.
ch.end: The report shows both areas with Bank and M-Pesa numbers counted today, and the bills owing.

ch.t: Check every job has a tech and a day
ch.do: Jobs → All techs. Look at each job.
ch.end: Every job shows 👷 a tech and 📅 a day. None says “Not yet”.

ch.do: Customers → 🗺️ Map. Find the Satellite cabinet hub.
ch.end: The map shows the hubs the Partner added (office, OLT room, Satellite cabinet).

days.title: First installs
days.story: Yesterday's four customers get connected. Six more call. The techs collect install fees and buy cable; Finance checks every shilling; the Partner puts the network on the map.

ch.end: The job is Done. NOTES: “Job done · collected KES 2,500 (cash)”. The router serial is under PARTS.

ch.do: Faith's Salon. ▶ I'm starting now. Router serial HWT30010001. 📷 photo of the router on the wall. What did you do: Ran new cable + Tested — working. 📱 M-Pesa 4500, code UKF3SALN45. ✅ Job finished — by 15:00.

ch.do: Mercy's install. ▶ I'm starting now. Router HWT10020001. 📷 photo. Did: Ran new cable + Tested — working. 💵 Cash 2500. ✅ Job finished.

days.title: The first money arrives
days.story: More installs. The billing website sends its first file (who paid, when they run out). Finance brings it in. A customer says he was charged twice — the first dispute.

ch.t: Bring in the billing file — payments
ch.do: Download “billing-payments-day3.csv” (link below) to your phone. Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file. What's in the file: Customer payments. Where it came from: Billnasi. Choose the file. Check the columns, then Import.
ch.where: Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file
ch.end: “… new payments · … already in · … matched to customers.” One payment is NOT matched (account 2002) and shows under “Payments not matched to a customer”. LEAVE it there until day 4.

ch.do: Router HWT10010004. Did: Ran new cable + Tested — working. He pays the install (2,500 — not his monthly 3,000) by 📱 M-Pesa 2500, code UKM7PETR25. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done with 2,500 (mpesa) UKM7PETR25.

ch.do: Hotel install. Routers HWT30010002 + HWT30010003 (two lines in PARTS). 📷 photo. 💵 Cash 4500 (the hotel will later say they also paid by M-Pesa). ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done, two routers in PARTS, collected 4,500 cash.

ch.do: Router HWT30020001. 📱 M-Pesa 4500, code UKI8ACAD45. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done, 4,500 (mpesa).

ch.t: Samuel Otieno and Ruth Chebet call
ch.do: Two new customers (voice): Samuel Otieno, TC, 0700 000 108, BW-1008, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Kamuyu road, after the posho mill”. Ruth Chebet, TC, 0700 000 109, BW-1009, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Next to the primary school”. Installs today, Tech 1.
ch.end: Two Leads with installs today for Tech 1.

ch.do: Call Call center 1 twice: Samuel Otieno 0700 000 108, Kamuyu road after the posho mill, 10 Mbps. Then Ruth Chebet 0700 000 109, next to the primary school, 10 Mbps.
ch.end: Both booked for today.

ch.t: Bring in the billing file — customer list
ch.do: Import again: What's in the file: Customer list, from Billnasi, file “billing-customers-day3.csv”. Import.
ch.where: Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file
ch.end: “… customers added or updated.” Open Mama Wanjiku: “Paid until 17 Nov”.

ch.do: 👥 Approvals: approve anything waiting that has a receipt. If a receipt is missing, ✋ Decline with the reason “No receipt — snap it and send again”.
ch.end: Nothing waiting at 10:00 and 11:45.

ch.do: Money → 👥 Customers → Who paid. Read the list.
ch.end: The customers who paid this month are there with amounts. Note any that look wrong.

ch.do: Isaac Ndungu (Satellite Academy), SA, 0700 000 204, BW-2004, Business 30 Mbps, 4500, “Satellite Academy, main gate”. Beatrice Wambui, SA, 0700 000 205, BW-2005, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Off the Suswa road, mabati house”. Installs today, Tech 3.
ch.end: Two Leads + installs today, Tech 3.

ch.do: Call Call center 2: Isaac Ndungu, head of Satellite Academy, 0700 000 204, business package. Then Beatrice Wambui 0700 000 205, off the Suswa road, mabati house, 10 Mbps.
ch.end: Both booked today; the school told 4,500 + 4,500.

ch.t: Install Samuel Otieno / Ruth Chebet (if booked)
ch.do: Do the Town Centre installs Call center 1 booked for you today. Routers HWT10010005 / HWT10010006. Did: Ran new cable + Tested — working. 💵 Cash 2,500 each.
ch.end: Each Done with router serial and 2,500.

ch.do: Router HWT10010007. 💵 Cash 2500. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done.

ch.do: Router HWT10020004. 💵 Cash 2500.
ch.end: Done.

ch.do: Me → ⚙️ Admin → Settings → 👥 Two people for money out → On — two people → Needs a second person above (KES): 1000 → Save. Tell Finance in the team group: “Rule is 1,000.”
ch.end: Settings shows On, above KES 1,000.

ch.do: After the Partner sets the rule to 1,000: Money out → KES 500 “TEST small payment”, Cash → Save. Then KES 5,000 “TEST big payment”, Cash → Save. Then delete the 500 test (✕).
ch.end: The 500 saved straight away. The 5,000 says it is waiting for a second person (the Partner).

ch.do: Pastor Moses Gitau, TC, 0700 000 110, BW-1010, Home 20 Mbps, 3000, “PCEA church compound”. Install day 4 (Tuesday), Tech 1.
ch.end: Lead + install Tuesday.

ch.do: Call Call center 1: Pastor Moses Gitau, PCEA church compound, 0700 000 110, 20 Mbps, Tuesday.
ch.end: Install Tuesday.

ch.do: Customers → 🗺️ Map. Are the new customers' pins near the hubs?
ch.end: Customers with green pins; each popup says how far the nearest hub is.

ch.do: Call center sends you a task: the hotel says they paid the install twice. Open Customers → Longonot View Hotel → PAYMENTS.
ch.end: Two payments of 4,500 (one field cash, one M-Pesa UKH4HOTL45). Write in the task: “Yes, paid twice — refund tomorrow after the Partner's OK.”

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → 👥 Approvals: Finance's “TEST big payment” (KES 5,000) is waiting. Tap ✋ Decline and give the reason “Test”.
ch.end: It leaves the waiting list and shows as declined. The KES 500 test did not need you at all.

ch.t: Delete a part you added by mistake
ch.do: On your next job → Parts: add “TEST cable” × 1 → then tap ✕ on it.
ch.end: TEST cable is gone, and stays gone after you close and open the job again.

ch.do: Find John Kamau. ＋ New job: Fault / no internet, “Very slow since yesterday”, Tech 2, today.
ch.end: Fault job for Tech 2 today.

ch.do: Call Call center 1 as John Kamau: “Since yesterday the internet is very slow.”
ch.end: A fault job; a tech comes today.

ch.do: Call center sends a fault job. Found: Bad connector. Did: Replaced connector + Tested — working. Parts: Fast connector, qty 2. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done with 2 connectors in PARTS.

ch.do: Snap the receipt (copy below). Equipment / Inventory, area Satellite. In “More”: VAT 345, supplier PIN P052222222B.
ch.end: Fibre World 2,500 in My receipts with VAT 345.
ch.copy: UKD4BWSPLC Confirmed. Ksh2,500.00 paid to FIBRE WORLD NAIVASHA. on 19/10/26 at 10:55 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh6,300.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.t: Cancel a job made by mistake, then reopen it
ch.do: ＋ New job for Mercy Atieno: Other, summary “TEST — made by mistake”. Open it → Cancel job. Then Reopen. Then Cancel job again.
ch.end: The job shows cancelled, then open, then cancelled. The notes on the job show each change.

ch.t: Snap a receipt from inside a job
ch.do: On your job → Spent money on this job? → 📸 → take a photo of any paper (pretend receipt), KES 200, Transport → Save.
ch.end: The receipt is saved on that job and waits in 👥 Approvals.

ch.t: The hotel says they paid twice
ch.do: The voice calls as the hotel manager. Find the hotel. Add a note on the hotel's install job: “Says paid install twice: cash 4,500 to the tech + M-Pesa UKH4HOTL45”. Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Finance: “Longonot View Hotel paid install twice — check and refund?”
ch.where: Jobs → note · Tasks → ＋ Add a task
ch.end: A note on the job and a task for Finance.

ch.do: Call Call center 2 as Daniel Kiprono of the hotel: “Your technician took 4,500 cash for the install, and my accountant ALSO paid 4,500 by M-Pesa, code UKH4HOTL45. I want my money back.” Be firm, not rude.
ch.end: They wrote down the code and promised Finance will check — not a promise of money on the spot.

ch.do: Count the cash: Town Centre Bank 215000, M-Pesa 61500. Satellite Bank 60000, M-Pesa 15200.
ch.end: Satellite float is above target now (green).

ch.do: My jobs → To do. Every open job: finish it or add a note why not.
ch.end: To do is empty, or every job left has a note.

ch.do: Every Town Centre customer installed so far (Peter, Lucy, Esther, the hotel, Samuel, Ruth — whoever is Done) → Status Active + Install date.
ch.end: All installed customers are Active. Leads are only the ones not yet connected.

ch.do: Tasks → 🤖 Run the manager now. Then Manager log.
ch.end: A line “Manager (…): … new · … closed …”. Read what it made.

ch.do: Joseph, Purity, Satellite Academy, Beatrice — whoever is Done → Active + Install date.
ch.end: Satellite: every connected customer is Active.

days.story: Satellite goes dark (a cut cable) — three customers call within half an hour. At the same time three money disputes arrive. The billing file says who has run out. Keep calm, keep it all in Zuri.

ch.do: Import “billing-payments-day4.csv” (Customer payments, Billnasi), then “billing-customers-day4.csv” (Customer list). Then Jobs → Check now (Payment follow-ups).
ch.where: Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file · Jobs → Check now
ch.end: Payments imported. Customer list updated. “Check now” says how many payment follow-ups opened (Joseph Kibet ran out yesterday).

ch.do: Router HWT10010008. 📱 M-Pesa 2500 code UKG9MOSE25. 📍 pin outside the church. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done with pin, router and 2,500.

ch.do: Joseph Kibet calls: internet off, but he paid 1,500 on Sunday, code UKJ7JOSE15. Open his payment follow-up (Jobs → 📩 Today's texts or his page) → ✅ Says paid. Then Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Finance: “Joseph Kibet paid 1,500 UKJ7JOSE15 — find it”.
ch.end: Follow-up note “Customer says they paid”, and a task for Finance with the code.

ch.do: Call Call center 2 as Joseph Kibet: “My internet went off yesterday! I paid 1,500 on Sunday. Code UKJ7JOSE15.” (You paid from your wife Mary's phone and typed the account as 2002 — you don't know that is wrong.)
ch.end: They took the code and said Finance will check today. Ask again at 11:00 — Finance should have found it.

ch.t: Dispute 1 — Joseph Kibet says he paid
ch.do: Task from Call center 2: Joseph paid 1,500, code UKJ7JOSE15. Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file → “Payments not matched to a customer” → find 1,500 UKJ7JOSE15 (account 2002) → Link → type Joseph → OK.
ch.end: “Linked.” Joseph Kibet's page → PAYMENTS shows 1,500 UKJ7JOSE15. Tell Call center 2. (In real life the billing website must be fixed too — write that in the task note.)

ch.do: Call center may send you a job at the hotel: add the part “Access point, serial AP-55001”. What did you do: Tested — working. ✅ Job finished, no money (included).
ch.end: Done with the access point in PARTS.

ch.do: Lucy calls: “The tech took 4,500, the price is 2,500!” Find her, read PAYMENTS. Ask Finance in the team group if unsure. Tell her: 2,500 install + 2,000 first month = 4,500. Add a note on her install job: “Explained 4,500 = install + first month”.
ch.end: A note on Lucy's install job with the answer.

ch.do: Call Call center 1 as Lucy Njeri: “Your technician took 4,500 from me but you said the install is 2,500!”
ch.end: They explained: 2,500 install + 2,000 first month.

ch.do: Open Lucy Njeri → PAYMENTS and her install job.
ch.end: One payment 4,500 (UKL5LUCY45) = 2,500 install + 2,000 first month. Not counted twice even though the billing file also had UKL5LUCY45. Tell Call center 1 the answer.

ch.do: Mercy: no internet, red light. Find her → ＋ New job: Fault / no internet, “No internet, red light”, Tech 3, today.
ch.end: Fault job for Tech 3.

ch.do: Call Call center 2 three times, 15 minutes apart: 10:00 Mercy Atieno (red light), 10:15 Purity Nyambura (no internet), 10:30 Isaac of Satellite Academy (“exams are online, URGENT”).
ch.end: Three fault jobs; after the third, they know it is an outage.

ch.do: Purity Nyambura: no internet. Fault job, Tech 3.
ch.end: Second Satellite fault in 15 minutes.

ch.do: Open a job with a pin → 📤 Send pin → send it to yourself on WhatsApp.
ch.end: The message opens Google Maps at the customer's house.

ch.do: Money → ✍️ Record → Money out: Town Centre, Paid to “Longonot View Hotel — refund”, Amount 4500, Category Other, Paid from M-Pesa, Ref UKR9HOTL45, note “Install paid twice (cash + UKH4HOTL45)”. Save.
ch.end: Waiting for a second OK. The Partner approves it.

ch.do: The school: no internet, exams online. Fault job, Priority Urgent, Tech 3. After saving, open Jobs.
ch.end: A red box: 📡 Possible outage in Satellite — 3 fault calls since 10:00.

ch.do: Read the team group. If the Partner asks, Tasks → find the outage task → 💬 Notes “Tech 1 free from 11:00”.
ch.end: Your note on the outage task (or nothing if not asked).

ch.do: Home or Jobs shows 📡 Possible outage in Satellite. Read the drafted customer notice. Change it if you want. Tap ✅ Yes, use this notice.
ch.end: “Yes saved. The office can copy the notice now.”

ch.do: 👥 Approvals: “Longonot View Hotel — refund” 4,500. Read the note. ✅ Approve.
ch.end: Approved. It shows who recorded and who approved.

ch.t: Many Satellite faults — go to the cabinet
ch.do: Three fault jobs at once = check the cabinet FIRST. Open one fault job → ▶ I'm starting now. Note: “At Satellite cabinet: fibre cut 50 m before the cabinet (road works)”. Tell the Partner in the group.
ch.end: Your note on the job; the Partner knows the cause.

ch.do: Before you make a job, open ＋ New job and pick Beatrice: read the red outage box. Tell her: we know, technicians are on it, no visit needed. Don't save a new job.
ch.end: No new job for Beatrice; she was told the truth.

ch.do: Call Call center 2 as Beatrice Wambui: “Is the internet down in Satellite?”
ch.end: They said yes, we know, technicians are on it — no visit.

ch.t: Skip a text, come back to it
ch.do: Jobs → 📩 Today's texts: on the first card tap ⏭ Skip. Work the rest. At the end tap ↺ Go through the skipped ones.
ch.end: The skipped card comes back at the end.

ch.do: Ann Muthoni, TC, 0700 000 111, BW-1011, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Behind the police post”. Install tomorrow, Tech 1.
ch.end: Lead + install tomorrow.

ch.do: My jobs → Done. Count your Done jobs since day 2.
ch.end: Write the number in your note. Does it match what you remember?

ch.do: Call Call center 1: Ann Muthoni (0700 000 111, behind the police post, 5 Mbps). Then Kevin Omondi (0700 000 112, green house near the water tank, 10 Mbps, tomorrow 10 am). Call Call center 2: Stephen Mutua (0700 000 206, near the chief's camp, 5 Mbps).
ch.end: Three installs booked for tomorrow.

ch.do: After the Partner says yes: open Jobs → the outage box → 📋 Copy the notice. Paste it in the team WhatsApp group with the words “(pretend broadcast to Satellite customers)”.
ch.where: Jobs → outage box → 📋 Copy the notice
ch.end: The notice is in the group, word for word.

ch.do: Kevin Omondi, TC, 0700 000 112, BW-1012, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Green house near the water tank”. Install tomorrow 10:00, Tech 2.
ch.end: Lead + install tomorrow.

ch.do: Bills: both KPLC prepaid bills were due on the 19th. 💸 Pay each: full amount, M-Pesa, codes UKK1KPLC40 (Town Centre 4,000) and UKK2KPLC20 (Satellite 2,000).
ch.end: Each shows “⏳ waiting for a second OK” until the Partner approves.

ch.do: Me → 🧾 My receipts. Any ❌ (no photo)? Tap 📸 Snap it now.
ch.end: No ❌ left.

ch.t: Fix it and close the faults
ch.do: Pretend you re-spliced. On EACH Satellite fault job: Found Fibre cut. Did Re-spliced the fibre + Tested — working. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: All three Satellite faults Done. Tell the Partner: “Service is back.”

ch.do: 👥 Approvals: both KPLC payments and Tech 3's receipts. ✅ Approve each.
ch.end: Nothing waiting. Bills shows both KPLC paid.

ch.do: Stephen Mutua, SA, 0700 000 206, BW-2006, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Near the chief's camp”. Install tomorrow (day 5), Tech 3.
ch.end: Lead + install tomorrow.

ch.do: Snap two receipts (copy below, then the second from your role card): Fibre World 1,200 (Equipment / Inventory) and fuel 600.
ch.end: Two receipts in My receipts, waiting for Finance.
ch.copy: UKE5BWSLEV Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to FIBRE WORLD NAIVASHA. on 20/10/26 at 11:40 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh5,100.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.t: Look 30 days ahead with a one-off
ch.do: Money → Next 30 days → One-off money in or out: tomorrow, −50,000, “TEST generator” → add. Read the lowest point. Then remove the one-off.
ch.end: The lowest point drops by 50,000 while it is there, and goes back when you remove it.

ch.do: When Tech 1 finishes Pastor Moses: Status Active + install date.
ch.end: Pastor Moses is Active.

ch.do: When Tech 3 says service is back: ✅ Service is back — close it.
ch.end: The red box is gone. Tell Call center 2.

ch.do: Call Call center 2 as Mercy: “It's back, asante!”
ch.end: They thanked you; Mercy's fault job is Done.

days.title: Pay day and reports
days.story: The 21st: staff pay day, and time for the VAT figures. Morning follow-ups for customers who ran out, the cash count, the pay run with two people, the VAT figures and the Friday report — printed.

ch.do: Count the cash: Town Centre Bank 210500, M-Pesa 52300. Satellite Bank 60000, M-Pesa 14100.
ch.end: Two counts today. Satellite float is just below target — orange warning. Note it for the report.

ch.t: Today's texts — customers who ran out
ch.do: Jobs → 📩 Today's texts (if it is empty, tap Jobs → Check now first). Esther Wairimu: call the voice → she will pay Saturday → 🤝 Will pay → In 3 days → Save. Samuel Otieno: call → no answer → 📵 No answer.
ch.end: Esther: “Promised to pay by …”. Samuel: “Called — no answer”, back tomorrow.

ch.do: Router HWT10010009. 💵 Cash 2500. ✅ Job finished. If the follow-up said her old service ran out, ignore — she is new.
ch.end: Done.

ch.do: Router HWT10020005. 💵 Cash 2500. 📍 pin. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done.

ch.do: Call center will call YOU today. Answer as: Esther Wairimu — “I will pay on Saturday.” Samuel Otieno — don't answer (let it ring). Peter Mwangi — “I'm moving to Naivasha, please stop it.” Joseph Kibet — “The office fixed it yesterday, thank you.”
ch.end: Each call ended with the right button in Zuri (ask them what they pressed).

ch.do: Jobs → 📍 Nearest first (allow location).
ch.end: The list orders itself by distance from where you stand.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → Pay run → 🔄 Build today's list.
ch.end: Under PAY NOW: six staff salaries (121,000) and the bills due by the 24th (rent, transport, pole rent, backhaul).

ch.do: Joseph's payment follow-up: Finance linked his payment yesterday. ✅ Says paid.
ch.end: “Customer says they paid — check the next billing import.”

ch.do: For each line: ✅ Sent — record it, M-Pesa (Bank for rent and backhaul), code UKP1… (use your role card list: UKP1SAL001 … UKP1SAL006, UKP2RENT15, UKP3TRAN03, UKP4POLE25, UKP5BACK35). Record it.
ch.end: Every line shows ⏳ waiting for a second OK. Nothing says “paid” yet — that is correct.

ch.do: Peter's follow-up: call the voice → he is moving to Naivasha → ✋ Wants to stop → OK.
ch.end: Closed. “Office can disconnect on the billing website.”

ch.do: Start Kevin's install at 11:10 (you were late on purpose). Router HWT10010010. 📱 M-Pesa 2500 code UKK3KEVI25.
ch.end: Done with the M-Pesa code. The job shows the call center's note about the delay.

ch.t: Ann Muthoni: no internet after install?
ch.do: Ann calls (voice): no internet. Her install is today — check the job: is Tech 1 on the way? 💬 Tell Tech 1 on WhatsApp.
ch.end: Ann was told the time; Tech 1 got the message.

ch.do: Me → 🧾 My receipts. Every receipt this week: is it there? Any ❌? Snap it now.
ch.end: Only 📷 or 📱 — no ❌.

ch.t: Call — Ann: is the tech coming?
ch.do: Call Call center 1 as Ann Muthoni: “When is the technician coming?”
ch.end: A clear time.

ch.t: Approve the pay run — two people
ch.do: 👥 Approvals. Approve every salary and bill EXCEPT Staff transport: ✋ Decline it with the reason “No receipt — snap it and send again”.
ch.end: Salaries and bills approved; Staff transport declined with your reason.

ch.do: Purity calls: slow in the evening since the outage. ＋ New job: Fault, “Slow in the evenings since Tuesday”, Priority Low, Tech 3, tomorrow.
ch.end: A low fault for tomorrow.

ch.do: If you didn't snap yesterday's fuel: snap it now (copy below), Transport / Fuel.
ch.end: Fuel 600 in My receipts.
ch.copy: UKE6BWFUEL Confirmed. Ksh600.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on 20/10/26 at 11:44 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh4,500.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.do: Call Call center 2 as Purity: “Since Tuesday it is slow every evening.”
ch.end: A job for tomorrow.

ch.t: Skip one line on the pay run
ch.do: Pay run: on one person tap ⏭ Skip → then 🔄 Build today's list again. Copy one person's M-Pesa number.
ch.end: The skipped person comes back after Build. The copied number is only digits.

ch.t: A fault call that is really an expired package
ch.do: The voice calls as a Satellite customer whose package ran out on day 3 (pick one who is Late). ＋ New job → Fault for them. Read the 💳 box → 💳 Turn this into a payment follow-up.
ch.end: No tech visit is made. A payment follow-up is made instead.

ch.do: The Partner declines Staff transport (no receipt). It is back on the Pay run as due. Snap the receipt (copy below) for 3,000 and record the line again with code UKP3TRAN03.
ch.end: Staff transport waiting again — this time with a receipt.
ch.copy: UKP3TRAN03 Confirmed. Ksh3,000.00 paid to MAAI MAHIU SACCO. on 21/10/26 at 10:40 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh49,300.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.do: When Finance re-records it with a receipt: open it, look at the 📷 receipt, ✅ Approve.
ch.end: Nothing waiting. Pay run: everything “Sent this month”.

ch.do: Money → 📊 Report → find 🧾 VAT (new box). Read: VAT on sales (estimate), VAT you can claim (receipts with a supplier PIN), VAT without a PIN, and the difference.
ch.end: October so far: claimable VAT includes Wavetech 4,828 and Fibre World 345. Write the four numbers in your note. (The October return is due 20 Nov.)

ch.do: Kevin calls: “He said 10 am!” Jobs → All techs → Tech 2. Open Kevin's job. 💬 Tell Tech 2 on WhatsApp. Add a note “Customer called 11:00 — tech late”.
ch.end: A note on the job; Tech 2 messaged.

ch.do: Tasks → My day. Tick what you did. Add a note on anything you could not do.
ch.end: My day up to date.

ch.t: Call — Kevin: the tech is late
ch.do: Call Call center 1 as Kevin Omondi: “He said 10 am. It is 11!” Be annoyed.
ch.end: They checked and gave you a new time, politely.

ch.t: Change a price, then change it back
ch.do: Me → ⚙️ Admin → Price list → Home 5 Mbps → change 1500 to 1700 → Save package. Open John Kamau's customer page. Then set Home 5 Mbps back to 1500 → Save package.
ch.end: While it was 1700, John Kamau still paid 1500 (old customers keep their price). It is back to 1500 now.

ch.do: 📊 Report → Export October to CSV. Open the file on the phone.
ch.end: A CSV with every expense (with VAT and PIN columns), money in, payments and counts.

ch.t: Try to approve your own payment
ch.do: Money → ✍️ Record → Money out: Town Centre, Paid to “Partner test”, 100, Other, M-Pesa. Save. Then go to 👥 Approvals and try to approve it yourself. Then ↩ Withdraw it.
ch.end: Zuri does NOT let you approve your own payment (no Approve button / “a second person must approve it”). After Withdraw it is gone.

ch.t: Customers who ran out — read Who paid
ch.do: Ask Finance to show you Money → Who paid on their phone (call center can't open Money). Compare with your follow-ups.
ch.end: Every customer who ran out has a follow-up job. Note any missing.

ch.do: Me → 🧾 My receipts. Snap any missing.
ch.end: No ❌.

ch.do: Me → Sign out. On the sign-in page tap Forgot password? → your email → open the email → set a new password → sign in.
ch.end: You are back in with the new password.

ch.do: 📊 Report → 🖨 Printable view → 🖨 Print / save as PDF (Save as PDF on the phone). Then Copy for WhatsApp and paste it in the team group.
ch.end: A PDF saved on your phone, and the report text in the group. It shows both areas, bills owing, payments waiting and receipts this week.

ch.do: Money → 📊 Report. Read it all.
ch.end: Post in the group: the cash after bills for each area, and one thing you would ask Finance about.
